title: Field boundaries for Austria (2025)
description: Agricultural field boundary polygons for Austria for the 2025 reference year, derived from official LPIS (Land Parcel Information System) data and conforming to the fiboa 0.3.0+ specification. Each parcel record includes polygon geometry, harmonized crop type codes (HCAT), native and English crop names, and area metrics.
